title: D Flip-Flop with Synchronous Reset
statement: Design a D flip-flop with synchronous active-high reset. On each rising clock edge, if reset is high the output should clear to zero; otherwise it should capture the D input. This is fundamental sequential storage for registered datapaths.
module_signature: module d_flipflop_sync_reset(input clk, input rst, input d, output reg q);
behavior: On rising clock edge, if rst is high, q becomes 0.
If rst is low, q follows d on the clock edge.
No asynchronous reset or direct set is allowed.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not infer asynchronous behavior or use latches.
hint: Use a clocked always block with rst in the sensitivity list for synchronous reset.
